unit.target: Cargo repository-local vendoring plus source-replacement configuration
verified: Cargo source replacement can redirect crates.io to a custom local directory source configured in .cargo/config.toml.
The official example defines [source.my-vendor-source] with directory = "vendor" and [source.crates-io] with replace-with = "my-vendor-source".
Directory sources contain unpacked crate source and per-crate .cargo-checksum.json metadata and are primarily managed by cargo vendor.
unit.exact_tested_scope: Documentation-level verification of the configuration semantics for consuming a prepared local directory source as a replacement for crates.io. No Cargo command, network isolation experiment, vendoring generation, build, or Chat-exposed executor was run.

scope_guard: This source verifies local directory replacement configuration only. It does not prove that a complete dependency set has already been vendored, that cargo vendor itself can run within scheduled Chat, that a build is fully offline, or that end-to-end richer-mode outcome parity is achieved.
